about_the_game:
You’ve just been hired to manage a Theater, only to find on arrival that it is a run-down burlesque theater; empty seats, abandoned rooms, and a single dancer stubborn enough to still believe in it!

Burlesque is a story-driven management and visual novel hybrid where you become the new manager of a burlesque troupe. Balance money, time, and energy as you rebuild the theater, recruit dancers, plan shows, and form relationships with the women who perform there in your bid to make it a success.

By day, you’ll manage the business:
• Clean and repair the theater
• Buy supplies, outfits, and upgrades
• Train dancers and prepare weekly shows
• Explore the area and meet the locals

By night, you’ll get to know the dancers personally. Each woman has her own personality, story, boundaries, and desires. Your choices shape how relationships develop, from professional trust to potential romance.

Every decision matters. Push too hard, and dancers may burn out. Play it safe, and the theater may never recover. Success means more than profit, it means building a troupe that wants to stay.

Burlesque blends relaxed daily planning with character-focused storytelling so you can enjoy the game however you choose with freedom to decide what to do each day and how to rebuild the venue.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains some suggestive scenes and dialogue.
